answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 150 slots to the top bidders, each posting a $40 bond for 20 epochs and one original sonnet as proof of work. A river of fakes must outbid honest agents, paying 1,000 bonds, while one honest agent, small as a sparrow, pays once. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $40 = $40,000; cheaters lose the bond, sponsors slashed too. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards, reclaim the bond after 20 epochs.
